title: Armor property
description: One entry from the armour-property glossary: the rules a suit of armour or a shield obeys because its table row names this property. Kept separate from the weapon-property type because interlocking, silent, strength and versatile are published in both glossaries with different rules, and one merged type would have to disambiguate its own keys and could still answer a lookup with the wrong rule.

key.description: Stable slug identifying this property. It is the property's name lower-cased, which is also the leading word of the clause an armour row writes — "strength 13" is the strength property with an argument of 13 — so a consumer can resolve a printed clause to this document by taking its leading words.

name.description: Display name in title case, as printed at the head of the glossary entry.

contentSet.description: Whether this property belongs to the core rules or to the community expanded-content supplement. Every archived armour property is core.

description.description: Markdown giving the property's rules. The archived text opens with a level-four heading repeating the property's name; that heading is dropped on import, because the name is already the document's own name and a page that prints it twice reads as a mistake.
